item.title: Glass helps Devils snap five-game skid with 4-3 win over Senators
item.description: OTTAWA — The New Jersey Devils snapped a five-game losing streak on Tuesday with a 4-3 win over the Ottawa Senators. Jakob Markstrom, who stopped 34 shots, made a number of saves in the final minutes to secure the victory.

item.title: Staying sober during the holidays: 8 expert tips for people in recovery and non-drinkers
item.description: If you're hosting a holiday gathering, small gestures can go a long way in supporting guests who don't drink.

item.title: Rantanen helps surging Stars ground struggling Jets 4-3
item.description: WINNIPEG — Jason Robertson scored his team-leading 19th goal of the season and Mikko Rantanen contributed three assists as the Dallas Stars extended their points streak to 11 games with a 4-3 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Tuesday.

item.title: Brunson's 35 points help Knicks bounce Raptors out of NBA Cup 117-101
item.description: TORONTO — Jalen Brunson had 35 points, including 20 in the first quarter, as the New York Knicks routed the undermanned Toronto Raptors 117-101 on Tuesday in an Emirates NBA Cup quarterfinal.

item.title: Bane scores 37 to lead the Magic past Heat 117-108 in NBA Cup quarterfinals
item.description: ORLANDO, Fla. (AP) — Desmond Bane matched his season high with 37 points and the Orlando Magic advanced to the NBA Cup semifinals with a 117-108 victory over the Miami Heat on Tuesday night.

item.title: Sabres' Tuch scores in overtime to spoil Oilers spirited comeback
item.description: EDMONTON — Alex Tuch scored the winner just 33 seconds into overtime as the Buffalo Sabres got a rare road win, coming away with a 4-3 victory over the Edmonton Oilers on Tuesday.

item.title: Alberta moves closer in debate to passing bill using notwithstanding clause 3 times
item.description: EDMONTON — Alberta Premier Danielle Smith’s government moved one step closer late Tuesday night to passing legislation invoking the Charter’s notwithstanding clause for a fourth time in this sitting.

item.title: Son arrested after Grammy-nominated singer Jubilant Sykes is stabbed to death at California home
item.description: SANTA MONICA, Calif. (AP) — Grammy-nominated singer Jubilant Sykes was stabbed to death at his home in Santa Monica, California, and his son was arrested on suspicion of murder, authorities said Tuesday.

item.title: Navy sailor rescued after falling overboard, spending two hours in water
item.description: The sailor was found in the frigid ocean waters east of Bentinck Island late Monday afternoon after falling off a rigid-hulled inflatable.
